title_sq: Ne Kombinat, Shitet Ambient Buze Rruge!!
description_sq: Ne Kombinat, ne Rrugen Fabrika e Qelqit, Shume afer meRrugen e Kavajes, Shitet Dyqan Perfekt Per Investim.!!! Dyqani me siperfaqe totale 36 m2, ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje pallati egzistues. Dyqani organizohet si nje ambient i vetem Openspace dhe nje tualet, gjithashtu ka edhe nje verande ne pjesen para e cila mund te shfrytezohet ne varesi te biznesit qe deshironi te zhvilloni. Ambjenti deri para pak kohesh ka sherbyer si lokal, por eshte i pershtatshem per tipologji te ndryshme biznesi. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In Kombinat, Street Side Room for Sale!!
description_en: In Kombinat, on Fabrika e Kelqi Street, very close to Kavaje Street, Perfect Store for Investment!!! The shop with a total area of ​​36 m2 is located on the 0th floor of an existing building. The shop is organized as a single Openspace environment and a toilet, there is also a veranda in the front part which can be used depending on the business you want to develop. The store is equipped with a glass facade, which gives the business a very good advertising opportunity. Until recently, the space served as a bar, but it is suitable for different types of business. The property has full mortgage documentation.
